title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Light of Intervention Pharaoh's Servant PSV-031 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a must-have for any collector or player. The Light of Intervention card, with the card number PSV-031, is a 1st Edition Common card from the Pharaoh's Servant set. It is a Trap-Continuous card with no defense or toughness, and no attack or power. 

This English language card, manufactured by Konami, has a few special features that make it a unique addition to any collection. It is perfect for anyone who loves the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game and wants to add a rare card to their deck. Don't miss out on the chance to own this special card!
